## Checklist

- [ ] **DCO**: every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), and the sign-off
      matches the commit author.
- [ ] **Tests pass**: `uv run pytest -q` is green, and I added or updated tests
      for this change.
- [ ] **SPDX headers** are present on any new source files
      (`# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0` + copyright line).
- [ ] **Benchmark citations complete** (if this touches `data/benchmarks/`):
      every figure is an individual cited value with source name, URL, date and
      a quality grade, and no whole table/dataset is reproduced
      (see [DATA_SOURCES.md](../DATA_SOURCES.md)).
- [ ] **No secrets or personal data**: no API keys, tokens, credentials, real
      client names or real account data in the diff.
- [ ] I understand code is contributed under Apache-2.0 and benchmark data under
      CC BY 4.0.
